requisitionList.Title: Principal Power Electrical Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Oracle is seeking an experienced On-Board Power Engineer in Santa Clara, California, or Burlington, Massachusetts, to develop power delivery systems for next-generation AI servers. The role owns power architecture, detailed design, testing, validation, and debugging from initial development through volume production, while collaborating with internal teams and vendors and mentoring junior engineers. Candidates should have strong experience with high-power multiphase voltage regulators, DC-DC converters, power integrity, PCB design, CAD tools, and control-loop tuning. Applicants must have a BSEE with seven years or an MSEE with five years of power engineering experience and include a resume.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Learning Consultant - Electronic Health Records (EHR) Experience
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
When you join Oracle Health Consulting as a Senior Learning Consultant professional, you become a part of a fast-growing team supporting our Federal customers in the largest electronic health record modernization effort.
 
The Senior Learning Consultant will be primarily responsible for facilitating and delivering engaging training programs for clients to support their adoption and successful use of our solutions. This role will work closely with senior training professionals to lead instructor-led and digital learning sessions tailored to client needs and business objectives. Key responsibilities include customizing training delivery for diverse client audiences, addressing client questions and concerns during sessions, and ensuring a positive, productive learning experience. The Senior Learning Consultant will also collaborate with client stakeholders and internal teams to gather real-time feedback, continuously enhancing the effectiveness and impact of client training engagements

requisitionList.Title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building some of the world’s largest AI clusters and bringing them to market at exceptional speed. requisitionList.Title: Oracle Open Technologies Renewal Account Manager- Government, Defense & Intelligence
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Oracle is seeking an Open Technologies Renewals Account Manager to own renewals and expansion opportunities for assigned customers within the Government, Defense, and Intelligence (GDI) division. Open Technologies consists of Oracle Java, Oracle Linux, and Oracle MySQL. This individual contributor will be accountable for renewal revenue, customer retention, and growth through both direct customer engagement and indirect/channel sales approaches.
The role requires prior Federal sales experience, and a collaborative approach to working with customers, channel partners, and other Oracle GDI teams. The Account Manager will manage the sales cycle from renewal planning and opportunity identification through proposal, negotiation, and contract execution, while helping customers maintain continuity and address evolving needs.
This is a U.S.-based REMOTE inside sales position.
Candidates must be U.S. citizens and have experience working with the Government
